meaning: For every finite measurable space with measurable singletons and normalized Mathlib probability measure, and every real threshold 0<t≤1, the heavy core C_t={x | 1-t<μ({x})} consists exactly of the points in every threshold-accepted event. Binary conjunction closure is equivalent to μ(C_t)≥t; the universal event is accepted and the empty event rejected. These are structural properties of the selected full-belief policy, not a reason-to-belief or epistemic-authority theorem.
